content.short: BlockSurvey offers end-to-end encrypted forms and surveys with no ads or trackers.
content.description: BlockSurvey encrypts your data and stores it in decentralized private storage that only you can access. You retain full ownership, and BlockSurvey cannot view your data, helping prevent leaks and breaches. Respondent privacy is prioritized with no ads, trackers, or cookies, so third‑party scripts cannot monitor responses. Each entry is end‑to‑end encrypted and collected under your control, preserving privacy. Surveys are intuitive, branded, and conversational, which can help improve completion rates while maintaining confidentiality.
